name: Analyze socio-economic systems using specific political theories
description: Users sought comparative analyses, definitions, and evaluations of various socio-economic systems, such as capitalism, socialism, feudalism, and communism. The requests often involved applying specific theoretical frameworks, particularly Marxist principles, to interpret historical events, political structures, and economic phenomena like ownership and surplus value.
